release_notes: Build 53 adds a targeted credential-recovery pass for installed Factburst Quiz Manager settings after the Build 52 data migration.
Missing OpenAI, Pexels, Pixabay, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram credentials are recovered independently from the previous development settings when a valid source is available.
Recovered credentials are validated and re-encrypted with Windows DPAPI for the current user; valid credentials already present in the installed app are never overwritten.
An unusable encrypted credential is cleared only after the installed settings file is backed up, preventing one corrupt token from making every API key appear blank.
Credential recovery does not replace the database or quiz projects, and it remembers credentials it imported so a key you later clear intentionally is not restored from the old checkout.
